name: Neobo Fastigheter
summary: Neobo Fastigheter AB (publ) is a Swedish property company dedicated to the management and enhancement of rental assets across the country. Its operations encompass a variety of offerings, including residential apartments, parking facilities, and commercial premises. Founded in 1999, the firm is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden. In December 2022, it rebranded from its previous name, Amasten Fastighets AB (publ), to Neobo Fastigheter AB (publ).
